description: The brand study: what the business really looks like, read from its own website. Answers its logo (the file of its own, never the logo of a platform the site is built on or a badge), the colours the logo is drawn in with their share, the brand colours those give, its own photos by address with their alt text, and notes on what could not be read. A website’s style sheets often carry the colours of the tool it was built with, so take the look from this, not from the site’s styles. Call it before drafting the brand, then import the logo and the best photos with media_from_url. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

url.description: The address of the business’s website, such as yourshop.com.

name: site_study
title: Read a business website
